topic: remove pilling (fuzz balls) from a sweater
core_question: How do I remove pills/fuzz balls from a sweater without damaging it? (secondary: How do I remove limescale buildup from an electric kettle?)
answer_summary: Lay the sweater flat and gently run a battery-powered fabric shaver or sweater comb over the fabric in one direction to shave off pills without snagging threads.; after the topic shift: Boil a mixture of equal parts water and white vinegar in the kettle, let it sit 15-20 minutes, discard and wipe out loosened scale, then boil plain water to rinse.
persona: anxious and rambling; writing in full careful sentences
